title: W013585 follow-up: four unproduced email attachments and identification of the records withheld (Axon Outpost / Q-865809)
summary:
Follow-up to W013585-100626, which the City closed on 2026-10-30 with 30 files and a statement that "portions" were withheld under Gov. Code § 7927.705 / Evidence Code § 954 without identifying which records. Three items:

- Item 1: four files named as attachments in emails the City produced but not included in the production, in the form transmitted: "AxonOutpost-Lightpost Bundles.pdf" (Axon, 2026-02-10), "Draft_Agenda_Report_Axon_Outpost_18_Month_Trial.docx" (2026-07-28), "Updated_Agenda_Report_Axon_Outpost_ALPR_Only.docx" (2026-07-29) and "San Mateo PD Axon council session.pdf" (2026-08-19). Quotes Gov. Code § 7927.500 (preliminary drafts "not retained by a public agency in the ordinary course of business") and asks that any exemption be identified per file,
- Item 2: for each record withheld under the 2026-10-30 determination, the record identifying it (date, sender, recipients, subject, request item) and the exemption applied, including any withholding list, privilege log or review notes, and the record identifying the persons responsible, citing Gov. Code § 7922.540(b) and (c),
- Item 3: any withheld record sent to or received from an axon.com address or otherwise shared outside the City, with Evidence Code § 912(a) waiver quoted; if such a record is withheld under § 954, the basis for the privilege.

Asks for native format (the two .docx files) and segregable portions under Gov. Code § 7922.525(b).

policy_promises.quote: An agency shall justify withholding any record by complying with Section 7922.000.

policy_promises.quote: preliminary drafts, notes, or interagency or intraagency memoranda that are not retained by a public agency in the ordinary course of business, if the public interest in withholding those records clearly outweighs the public interest in disclosure
policy_promises.tests: Are the two agenda-report drafts and the council-session plan, each retained as an email attachment, produced or withheld, and on what stated public interest?
